21. Which team will play the most games at the stadium this month? A. Washington Commanders. B. Los Angeles Rams. C. Los Angeles Chargers. D. New Orleans Saints. 答案：B 原文明确说Rams每个赛季在此打最多的主场比赛。
22. Which hotel is the nearest to the stadium? A. Sonder Lum Hotel. B. The Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles. C. The H Hotel Los Angeles. D. The Renaissance LA Airport Hotel 答案：A 原文说Sonder Lum Hotel就在体育场街对面，是最近的。
23. What do you need to do if you want to park at the stadium? A. Call the parking staff. B. Prepay the parking fee. C. Obtain a parking pass. D. Choose a parking zone. 答案：C 原文建议通过ParkWhiz提前购买停车通行证。
24. What does Kevin usually do to get the meaning of a word? A. Use electronic devices. B. Consult a paper dictionary. C. Guess from the context. D. Turn to his English teacher. 答案：A Kevin不知道词典按字母顺序编排，说明他平时用电子设备查词。
25. How did Kevin feel while looking up the word in the dictionary? A. Annoyed. B. Disappointed. C. Encouraged. D. Astonished. 答案：D 他看到整页同前缀单词时既惊恐又敬畏，即感到震惊。
26. What can we learn about the author's first dictionary? A. It helped her through the college. B. It was given to Kevin as a gift. C. It bore witness to her efforts. D. It was a valuable limited edition. 答案：C 作者在词典上做标记，词典见证了她的努力。
27. What has the author come to realize about learning? A. It is never too late to start. B. Motivation is what really matters. C. Children need role models. D. Dictionaries are still a useful tool. 答案：B 作者说做标记是出于兴趣和体验，强调内在动机的重要性。
28. What does the new study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums? A. They affect the growth of other trees. B. They absorb less carbon than expected. C. They harm people's health indirectly. D. They raise the local temperature slowly. 答案：C 橡树和枫香树释放的异戊二烯与氮氧化物形成臭氧，间接危害健康。
29. Which of the following may Commane suggest based on their study? A. Cutting down the isoprene-producing trees. B. Suspending tree-planting for a few decades. C. Changing the species of trees in new plantings. D. Removing isoprene released by existing trees. 答案：C Commane说种树要小心，暗示应改变新植树的树种。
30. What does the underlined phrase "oblivious to" in paragraph 5 mean? A. Honest about. B. Unaware of. C. Related to. D. Optimistic about. 答案：B oblivious to意为“未意识到”，即unaware of。
31. What does the study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums? A. They attract the southern pine beetle. B. They absorb less carbon than expected. C. They suffer because of human activities. D. They raise the local temperature. 答案：D 研究指出这些树产生的异戊二烯会提高夏季臭氧水平，即影响当地空气。
32. What can be inferred about the city's tree-planting strategy? A. It may cause some problems. B. It has proved to be a failure. C. It targets areas in great need. D. It requires further improvement. 答案：A 若沿用以往树种模式，会加剧臭氧污染，说明该策略可能带来问题。
33. According to the study, which group was more likely to think beyond daily life? A. Trees: A Solution to Climate Change B. Trees: A Victim of Climate Change C. Urban Trees: A Double-edged Sword D. Urban Trees: A Key to Cooler Cities 答案：C 文章讲城市树木既净化空气又可能加剧臭氧，是双刃剑。
34. Why did the researchers ask about the participants' feelings? A. To compare the two groups' scores. B. To judge their specific thinking pattern. C. To measure the difficulty of the task. D. To identify the true factor behind the results. 答案：D 研究者通过感受问题判断美感体验是否是结果背后的真正因素。
35. What does the study encourage people to do? A. Visit galleries more often. B. Spend less time on screens. C. Buy handmade ceramics. D. Develop their critical thinking. 答案：A 研究鼓励人们多接触艺术之美，即多参观美术馆。
36. Museums, once silent halls of the past, are now using artificial intelligence (AI) in surprising ways. Walk into many modern galleries today and an AI-powered guide can chat with you, answer your questions, and share fascinating stories about the works on display. 36___________. 答案：C 该句总结AI正多方面改变博物馆体验，承接上文。
37. The ways in which AI assists visitors are truly surprising. 37__________. Virtual guides can respond in dozens of languages and adjust their tone to suit each listener, whether a young student or a lifelong art lover. They make every visit feel personal. 答案：F 下文讲虚拟导览多语言、调语气，对应AI聊天机器人取代传统语音导览。
38. AI can also examine artworks in fine detail, far beyond what is possible with human eyes. 38__________. Moreover, it can predict how a fragile painting may age over the years, allowing experts to step in before any visible damage appears. 答案：A 下文讲AI能预测画作老化，说明其是艺术品修复的有力工具。
39. Beyond preservation, AI creates tailored experiences for individual visitors and their families. 39__________. For instance, a curious child and a trained art expert standing before the same painting might each receive a completely different guided tour. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：D 下文举例儿童与专家获得不同导览，说明AI按年龄和学习风格定制推荐。
40. Yet the growing use of AI also raises concerns. These systems depend on collecting vast amounts of personal information through their data-driven algorithms. 40___________ Strict rules are therefore needed to ensure that every visitor's privacy is fully protected. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：B 上文讲收集大量个人信息，下文讲需要严格规则保护隐私，B项衔接最顺。
41. The 41 ______ that people only really knew Ohio for the three C's - Cleveland, Cincinnati, or Columbus (not Cortland!) - came quickly when I decided to go to school in central Pennsylvania. A. fantasy B. prejudice C. realization D. expectation 答案：C “意识到人们只知俄亥俄三C”是作者去宾州上学后的认识。
42. Half of my peers didn't even realize I lived a 42 ______ three and a half hours away. A. only B. indeed C. still D. even 答案：A 强调我住的地方离他们只有三个半小时车程，用only。
43. The 43 ______ are never-ending. A. tests B. questions C. games D. debates 答案：B 下文列举同学们不断提出的问题，故为questions。
44. I was a unicorn in their eyes, a 44 ______ Or, on second thought, maybe just a country hick. A. success B. victim C. novelty D. problem 答案：C unicorn指稀有新奇之物，与novelty（新奇事物）对应。
45. As I grow older, I'm more and more 45 ______ for my small town roots. A. thankful B. hopeful C. suitable D. reliable 答案：A be thankful for意为“感激”，与后文grateful呼应。
46. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. dream B. lie C. bear D. complain 答案：D complain about how bored we were 抱怨无聊，符合语境。
47. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. therefore B. however C. instead D. otherwise 答案：B 前后为转折关系，用however。
48. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. touring B. challenging C. leaving D. protecting 答案：C 离开小镇后才意识到自己多爱它，用leaving。
49. For one, the pace of life isn't anxiety provoking and people really 49 ______ connecting to each other. A. value B. admit C. fear D. remember 答案：A 小镇生活节奏不焦虑，人们重视彼此联系，用value。
50. That means that you do more than just talk to your next door neighbors - in a lot of cases, they're truly so 50 ______ of your family. A. advantage B. example C. owner D. extension 答案：D 邻居几乎是家庭的延伸，an extension of your family。
51. So much of this 51 ______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52 ______ is a critical part of the culture. A. lifestyle B. landscape C. procedure D. personality 答案：A 这种生活方式围绕户外活动，用lifestyle。
52. So much of this 51 ______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52 ______ is a critical part of the culture. A. findings B. surroundings C. belongings D. greetings 答案：B 留意周围环境是文化的重要部分，用surroundings。
53. As I move through my college years, I 53 ______ the visits to my little hometown. A. give up B. put off C. face up to D. look forward to 答案：D 大学期间期待回小镇探访，用look forward to。
54. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：B 感激成长的环境，the surroundings that I had growing up。
55. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：A 让小镇根基指引方向，用rely on。
56. It is also common for them 56 ____ (hold) on traditional Chinese holidays such as the Spring Festival, also known as the Chinese New Year, and Mid-Autumn Festival, as well as other local festivals. 答案：to hold it is common for sb to do sth固定结构。
57. The exact dates and 57 ____ (frequent) of daji vary from region to region. 答案：frequency 与dates并列作主语，需名词形式。
58. Dajis evolved from the folk custom of trading goods, which can be traced back to 58 ____ Han Dynasty (202 B.C.-A.D. 220). 答案：the 朝代前用定冠词the Han Dynasty。
59. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ____ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ____ (necessity). 答案：were 主语为transportation and communication，过去时用were。
60. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ____ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ____ (necessity). 答案：necessities daily necessities日常必需品，用复数。
61. They would trade their surplus items 61 ____ the goods they needed. 答案：for trade A for B用介词for。
62. Today, residents from surrounding areas flock to these markets. 62____ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63____ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：Drawn 过去分词作状语，表被动“被香味吸引”。
63. Today, residents from surrounding areas flock to these markets. 62____ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63____ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：for hurry to...for...表示匆忙去取某物。
64. Before 64 ____ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ____ (cheap)than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：heading before后接动名词heading。
65. Before 64 ____ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ____ (cheap)than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：cheaper much修饰比较级，用cheaper。
—— 共 45 题 ——
